By continuing, you agree to this, as described in our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.Agent saidHi, I’m Adina, your personal BODi virtual assistant. I can help you find your perfect fitness program. Just let me know what you’re looking for— feel free to include things like your fitness goals, experience level, or favorite workout style so I can make the best recommendation.You saidHi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?Agent saidAbsolutely, I’d be happy to help. To get started, could you share a bit about your goals or preferences? For example, are you interested in weight loss, building strength, improving flexibility, or just getting more active? Also, do you prefer workouts like cardio, strength training, yoga, or something else? This will help me recommend a few programs that fit your needs.You saidCan you explain the main options in simple terms?Agent saidSure. Here are some main types of workouts you’ll find on BODi:Cardio: Great for burning calories and improving heart health. Includes dance, HIIT, and cycling.Strength training: Uses weights or bodyweight to build muscle and get stronger.Yoga and Pilates: Focuses on flexibility, balance, and core strength.Barre: Combines ballet-inspired moves with strength and flexibility.Mixed programs: Blend different styles, like cardio and strength, for a balanced approach.If you tell me what sounds interesting or what your goals are, I can recommend a couple of specific programs to help you get started.You saidFor a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?Agent saidFor a first-timer, the safest and easiest choices are beginner programs with simple movements and low impact. Here are a few options:For Beginners Only: Low-impact cardio, strength, and mobility workouts designed for absolute beginners.10 Minute Beginner: Short, approachable workouts to build confidence and strength, just 10 minutes at a time.Walk Week: Easy-to-follow walking workouts you can do at home, no treadmill needed.Would you like more details about any of these, or do you have a preference for a certain style (like walking, strength, or cardio)?You saidI don't want to overpay while I'm still learning, what's a good starter pick?Agent saidA good starter pick that’s affordable and easy is the 10 Minute Beginner program. It offers short, simple workouts and you can try it with a 10-day free trial if you choose the 10 Minute BODi subscription, which is $10/month.Another option is For Beginners Only, which is designed for absolute beginners and included with a regular BODi subscription (currently $19/month, with a 7-day free trial).If you prefer walking, Walk Week is a gentle, easy-to-follow program.Would you like more details about any of these options, or info on how to start a free trial?You saidWhat do beginners usually say about it in reviews?Agent saidI don’t have access to reviews or feedback from beginners about these programs. If you’d like, I can help you find more details about the workouts themselves or guide you through starting a free trial. Let me know what you’d like to do next.You saidIs there anything else a beginner needs to get started?Agent saidTo get started as a beginner, you’ll need a few basics:Most beginner programs use light dumbbells (1–3 lbs) and sometimes resistance bands or a mat.You don’t need fancy equipment or a gym—just a bit of space at home.You can stream workouts on your computer, tablet, or phone.If you want to try walking workouts, Walk Week only needs light dumbbells.
